g.text: POST /api/aircraft-models (modelName, manufacturer, seatingCapacity, fuelCapacity, maximumRange, cruisingSpeed)
Requests from other components forward the end user's JWT (+ X-Service-Key).
"System" = any of the 3 replicas: every GET answers from the local read models, which hold
the data of all replicas and the Flight Routes data received by events (never partial).
